scan.summary: This is a training and evaluation record for operators of powered industrial trucks (forklifts and pallet jacks) at the Portland facility, maintained under OSHA 29 CFR 1910.178(l) and Oregon OSHA rules. It documents formal instruction, practical training, initial evaluation, and three-yearly re-evaluation for three operators, and identifies the certified trainer.
